name: com.hjhjy.xy.wxapi.WXEntryActivity
description: After a player shares through WeChat from the YYXXGame YYXX Comm sharing SDK, WeChat returns here with the result; this Activity reports whether the share succeeded, was cancelled, or failed.
disableEffect: The WeChat share result is not returned to the YYXX Comm SDK, so the in-app sharing flow may not complete.
